art_direction_narrative: The Bernat Solutions brand represents 'Industrial Luxury' and 'High-End Brutalism'. The design breaks away from generic B2B templates, leaning into a bold, architectural, and cinematic direction. It uses deep shadows, raw steel textures, and high-contrast vibrant orange accents to convey reliability, precision, and modern engineering. Motion is a core pillar: deliberate, smooth, and premium, treating the website as a high-end editorial piece rather than just a brochure. The aesthetic is heavy, confident, and unapologetic.

primary.usage: Headings, hero text, manifestos, large numbers. Selected for its tall, commanding, and rigid industrial structure. All uppercase for maximum impact.

secondary.usage: Body copy, labels, forms, UI elements. Chosen for its clean, geometric, and highly readable nature, contrasting perfectly with the rigid headings.

rules: H1 should use fluid typography (clamp) up to text-7xl or text-8xl on desktop, with tight tracking (-tracking-tighter) and tight leading (leading-[0.9]).
Labels/Overlines must be uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs or text-sm, often in the accent color.
Body text should be text-lg or text-xl with leading-relaxed.
Never use pure black (#000) or pure white (#FFF). Always tint slightly.
The accent color (#FF4500) must be used sparingly as a 'laser beam'—for CTAs, active states, and critical data points. Do not oversaturate the layout with it.
Use #141414 and #1E1E1E for surface elevation, separated by subtle 1px borders (#262626).

textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-5%) across the entire background to kill the 'digital flatness'.
Metal plate or concrete texture used inside large typography or hero masks.
shadows: Avoid soft, diffuse drop shadows. Use harsh, short shadows or solid 1px borders to define shapes.
Use 'spotlight' radial gradients behind key product images or cards to simulate real-world factory lighting.
borders: Heavy use of border-collapse grid layouts.
Cards should have 1px solid borders. No rounded corners (rounded-none) or very sharp (rounded-sm) to maintain the brutalist industrial feel.

motion_and_interaction.scrolling: Mandatory use of @studio-freight/lenis for smooth, momentum-based scrolling. This elevates the perceived quality.
motion_and_interaction.kinetic_hero: The hero text must use framer-motion to reveal line-by-line using a 'mask' (overflow-hidden wrapper on each line, translating Y from 100% to 0).
motion_and_interaction.editorial_marquee: Use react-fast-marquee or framer-motion to create a slow-moving, infinite scrolling text band (e.g., 'LASER CUTTING • FOLDING • WELDING • FINISHING •'). Large outline text, tracking wide.
motion_and_interaction.scroll_reveals: Sections must fade in and slightly translate up (y: 40 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1) as they enter the viewport using framer-motion's 'whileInView'.
motion_and_interaction.parallax: Hero image or background texture should subtly translate Y on scroll. Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Buttons should have a magnetic feel or a hard 'fill' animation (e.g., background slides in from the left). Images should slightly scale up inside their clipped containers.

manifesto_chapters.description: The 4-step process. Each step is a full-width 'chapter'.
manifesto_chapters.layout: Massive background numbers (e.g., '01') in a low-opacity steel color. Content overlaps the number. Sticky positioning so they stack on scroll.

service_card.description: Cards showcasing Laser Cutting, Folding, etc.
service_card.layout: Tall, portrait-oriented cards. Clipped image at the top (grayscale until hovered). Bold title, minimal text. A sharp arrow icon in the corner. Hovering reveals full color and a spotlight effect.

quote_form.layout: Use Shadcn components heavily customized to look brutalist (sharp edges, dark backgrounds, high-contrast borders). Multi-select for processes. Large dropzone for drawings. Sticky summary panel on the right.

industry_chip.layout: Pill or sharp-edged rectangle with a 1px border. On hover, background fills with the accent color and text turns white. Arranged in a dense flex-wrap layout.

sticky_nav.layout: Glassmorphism with extreme blur (backdrop-blur-2xl) and a dark tint (bg-black/80). 1px bottom border. Contains logo, main links, and a solid orange 'Request a Quote' button.

Home: Hero: Kinetic typography reveal, massive H1, subtle parallax background.
Reassurance: 'Need a backup supplier?' block. High contrast, large bold text.
Marquee: Slow editorial scroll of capabilities.
Benefits Bento: 6 cards in a dense, asymmetric grid.
Services Showcase: Horizontal scroll or grid of tall service cards.
Manifesto Chapters: 4-step process with sticky stacking.
Trust & SEO: 'Built for Busy Buyers' blocks + local SEO chips.
Pre-footer Quote Form: Embedded form or massive CTA leading to the form.
layouts_blueprint.Services: Hub page listing all capabilities with deep dives, machinery specs, and video/image loops.
layouts_blueprint.Service Specific Pages (Laser, Folding,: Hero with specific machinery imagery. Technical specs table. Material capabilities. Gallery. Quote CTA.
layouts_blueprint.Industries: Grid layout detailing how Bernat serves construction, automotive, aerospace, etc.
layouts_blueprint.About: The 'Why'. Factory floor photography. Values. The team behind the supplier network.
layouts_blueprint.Quote: Dedicated page. Left column: The form (Shadcn customized). Right column: Trust badges, testimonials, and contact info (sticky).
layouts_blueprint.Contact: Direct lines, email, map, and a simple message form.
layouts_blueprint.Admin Dashboard: Hidden behind /admin. Uses Shadcn heavily. Sidebar nav. Data table for quotes, leads, and analytics.

hero_background.description: Dramatic welding sparks in a dark industrial setting. Perfect for hero background with overlay.

welding.description: Intense welding sparks from a metal frame.

factory_floor.description: Interior of a large industrial factory.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Set the overall background to the dark theme (#0A0A0A) immediately in index.css.
CRITICAL: Load 'Oswald' and 'Manrope' fonts from Google Fonts in index.html or layout wrapper.
Do not use generic border-radius. Everything should be sharp (rounded-none) or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm) to fit the brutalist industrial theme.
Build the Kinetic Hero first. Ensure the 'masked line-by-line' reveal works perfectly using framer-motion.
For the Quote Form, use Shadcn form components but strip away the default soft borders and shadows. Make them look harsh, using 1px borders (#404040) and sharp corners.
Ensure all images have an overlay or a 'spotlight' treatment to blend into the dark theme.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical, bento-style grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use modern, sharp button styles with interaction animations and the brand orange accent.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
